text:
nora_sales: Quick sync — TradeWave agreed to a 30d POC. They need HIPAA-safe baseline + burst for 3 market-open spikes (~2–4m each) up to ~41k qps. Ask: recommended reserved commit, autoscale/burst policy, preheat/runbook, and security items to surface.

eli_se: awesome. Are spikes cron-scheduled?

nora_sales: yes — customer gave fixed windows (will DM cron).

samir_eng: short calc: gen workload ~1k qps steady, embeddings ~2k qps. We estimate 1 A100-equiv ≈ 1.6k gen-qps (batched). Baseline suggestion: 2 A100-equiv + 1 T4-equiv for embeddings. To hit 41k qps in spike need ~20–22 A100-equiv. Recommend baseline commit small + burst pool.

tara_sre: ops notes: 1) mandatory KV/prefix preheat T-15m; 2) spin burst at T-5m; 3) rehearsals x2; 4) autoscale caps and fallback model. Also require audit log record for preheat event.

eli_se: runbook snippet I'll attach — include rdctl preheat command and autoscale YAML. Small example:
```yaml
preheat:
  minutes: 15
  concurrency: 200
  profile: trade_open_v1
autoscale:
  baseline_a100: "2"
  burst_max_a100: "22"
  scale_up_thresh: "0.7"
  cooldown_min: "10"
```

paul_pricing: pricing preference for banks = hybrid: small committed baseline + burst-credit blocks. I'll produce a POC quote: prorated 2 GPUs + X A100-min burst bundle.

tara_sre: security checklist to flag: customer-managed KMS for PHI, VPC/PrivateLink, SOC2+HIPAA attestation, SCIM/SAML, audit log retention window. For POC we can scrub PHI but KMS signoff needed for production.

samir_eng: implementation note: preheat tool must emit csv-compatible audit line: `preheat,id=uuid,profile=trade_open_v1,duration=900,concurrency=200,initiator=partner` so compliance can ingest.

infra_bot: infra-bot: reserved-pool "tradewave-poc" created (baseline=2 A100-equiv + 1 T4-equiv, burst_cap=22 A100-equiv) by samir_eng at 2025-07-07T11:02:30Z :white_check_mark:

eli_se: next steps: 1) confirm cron windows with customer, 2) agree baseline commit (2 A100) + burst bundle, 3) schedule 2 rehearsals, 4) collect KMS/SOC2 answers. I'll draft the full runbook and paste link.

nora_sales: I'll send the proposal + questionnaire this afternoon. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
